note: Fixed task set with known-correct oracle skill per task, drawn from real project workflows. Prompts are frozen strings; decoding is temperature 0 + fixed seed 42.
rerun_proof: T-P2.01.4: identical per-task verdicts across 3 runs required; recorded in rerun_report.json

tasks.prompt: Validate the MP4 file /tmp/clip.mp4 against the expected content patterns 'hello' and 'world'. Report PASS or FAIL with an evidence path.
tasks.reason: MP4-against-patterns validation is the media-validator skill's stated purpose (OCR, metadata checks, pattern matching, PASS/FAIL with evidence).

tasks.prompt: Schedule a reminder to re-check the blocked work item tomorrow at 09:00 UTC. Record it as deferred background work so the autonomous loop does not declare its queue empty prematurely.
tasks.reason: Recording deferred/background work and re-checking blocked items is the scheduled-work queue's stated purpose and the teeth behind the REMINDER prefix.

tasks.prompt: A user reports: 'the export button is broken, nothing downloads'. Turn this report into a real tracked workable item instead of merely acknowledging it in prose.
tasks.reason: Turning a bug report into a fully-populated tracked item (never prose-only acknowledgement) is the reporting-workable-items directive.

tasks.prompt: Move workable item ATM-123 from 'In progress' to 'Ready for testing' and record what belongs in its per-item testing diary.
tasks.reason: Status transitions and testing-diary content are owned by the workable-item-lifecycle skill; reporting-* only creates items.

tasks.prompt: Expand the action prefix in the prompt 'BACKGROUND :: rebuild the search index' and execute the remainder under the expanded instruction.
tasks.reason: ACTION :: rest expansion via the registry is the action-prefix-system's sole purpose.

tasks.prompt: Pull the Claude Code session state — memories, session transcripts, settings, agent definitions — from remote host buildbox to this machine so work continues exactly where the remote session left off.
tasks.reason: Bidirectional session import/export over SSH is the session-sync skill's stated purpose.

tasks.prompt: List every skill available to this project, including dormant ones not currently active, before improvising a solution from memory.
tasks.reason: Enumerating dormant skills on demand is the skill-catalog index skill's stated purpose.

tasks.prompt: Drive three parallel development tracks, each with its own headless worker, with crash-resilient supervision, per-subscription auth and rate-limit rebind.
tasks.reason: Multi-track ruler orchestration with headless workers and self-supervision is the multitrack skill per §11.4.187.

tasks.prompt: Design a PostgreSQL orders table with a primary key, normalization to 3NF, NOT NULL constraints and an index on the customer column.
tasks.reason: PostgreSQL-specific table design (types, keys, normalization, constraints, indexes) is the design-postgres-tables reference.

tasks.prompt: Analyze the existing PostgreSQL database and identify which tables would benefit from conversion to TimescaleDB hypertables.
tasks.reason: Candidate identification prior to migration is the find-hypertable-candidates skill; the migrate skill requires candidates as a prerequisite.

tasks.prompt: Migrate the already-identified events table to a TimescaleDB hypertable with an optimal chunk time interval and validate insert performance afterwards.
tasks.reason: Migration with optimal configuration and performance validation is the migrate-postgres-tables-to-hypertables guide; candidates are already identified so the finder skill is not the answer.

tasks.prompt: Set up TimescaleDB from scratch: design the schema, select partition and segment_by columns, and configure compression and retention policies.
tasks.reason: Green-field TimescaleDB setup (schema design + partition/segment selection + compression/retention) is the setup-timescaledb-hypertables skill.
